issues.title: Implement UI for table of active players
issues.body:
This is to implement the component to view the table of active players:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/149301863-5870f122-80f4-4c73-ac80-38d5b7a652c4.png)

The development of the above UI is discussed: #1218

1. The component will be displayed in a popup dialog
2. When open, the component will refresh every 5 seconds
3. The data for the columns comes from here:
    a. The list of messages (and ages) comes from `playerLog` in the `PlayerUIState`
    b. The time since last logged in comes from the `\playerlog` REST end-point on the server
    c. The list of players is the _union_ of all of the roles returned by the above two sources
4. The red/green bullet at the left of the `Role` items is green if there is a `playerlog` entry for that role within the last minute
